description: This file defines a React component 'GuardrailsPage' that renders a guardrails panel. It imports a GuardrailsPanel component and a custom hook 'useAuthorized' to obtain an access token, and then passes that token as a prop to the panel.

methods.name: GuardrailsPage
methods.description: React functional component that retrieves an access token via a hook and renders the GuardrailsPanel component.
